description: Given a domain, tells whether it is a real, live and established business domain: DNS (A, MX, NS, SPF, DMARC, DNSSEC), registration from RDAP (registrar, created and expiry dates, age, status; never registrant contacts), the TLS certificate (valid, issuer, expiry) and the website (final URL, status, HSTS), with risk flags such as newly registered, no MX or invalid TLS. 'Does not exist' is an answer. Not charged if lookups fail. Costs $0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, eip155:8453); failures are not charged.
name: domain_verify
title: Domain verification
